fertility-specialist.label: Fertility specialist
fertility-specialist.includes: A private video call to look at where you both are, which tests are worth doing, and what a sensible plan for the next six months looks like.

gynaecologist.label: Gynaecologist
gynaecologist.includes: For irregular cycles, painful periods, PCOS or endometriosis. Or for a check-up before you start trying.

obstetrician.label: Obstetrician
obstetrician.includes: For a pregnancy question that cannot wait for your next visit: a report, a symptom, a BP or sugar reading, or a plan you want to understand.

male-fertility.label: Male fertility specialist
male-fertility.includes: How to read a semen analysis properly, what can change and what cannot, and when it is worth seeing a urologist or andrologist in person.

fetal-medicine.label: Fetal medicine specialist
fetal-medicine.includes: For a screening result, a scan finding or a growth worry. Go through your reports and the next steps, in plain words.

neonatology.label: Neonatologist
neonatology.includes: For parents of a baby born early or after a NICU stay. Feeding, weight, follow-up checks and what to watch for at home.

paediatrics.label: Paediatrician
paediatrics.includes: For questions about your child's health, growth or development that need more time than a clinic visit gives.

developmental-paediatrics.label: Developmental paediatrician
developmental-paediatrics.includes: For a worry about speech, movement, play or learning. Which assessments help, and what early support looks like.

paediatric-neurology.label: Paediatric neurologist
paediatric-neurology.includes: For seizures, movement concerns or a neurology report. What it means, and what to ask at the next visit.

paediatric-cardiology.label: Paediatric cardiologist
paediatric-cardiology.includes: For a heart murmur, an echo report or life after heart surgery. What the findings mean, and the follow-up plan.

perinatal-mental-health.label: Perinatal mental health specialist
perinatal-mental-health.includes: A private call for low mood, worry or feeling not yourself, in pregnancy or after birth. Partners are welcome too.

genetic-counselling.label: Genetic counsellor
genetic-counselling.includes: For carrier results, cousin marriage, a family condition or a screening result. Your options, explained without pressure.

speech-therapy.label: Speech therapist
speech-therapy.includes: For a child who is late to talk or hard to understand. What to try at home, and whether therapy would help.

child-psychology.label: Child psychologist
child-psychology.includes: For worry, behaviour, attention or school stress. Practical steps for home, and whether an assessment is worth it.

lactation.label: Lactation consultant
lactation.includes: For latch, pain, low supply or pumping. A lactation consultant looks at what is happening and what to change.
